subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should experimental `claws add` be allowed to install or reuse a process-wide plugin after exact-plan consent while later plugin removal remains warning-only for dependent Claw agents?
rationale: The implementation can bind artifact identity and show warnings, but it cannot determine the repository's intended authority boundary between an agent-scoped Claw lifecycle and shared host plugin execution/removal.

options.title: Approve explicit shared-host consent
options.body: Retain the current exact-plan grant and warning-only uninstall model, contingent on real shared-plugin proof and stack-level upgrade review.

options.title: Require a stronger removal gate
options.body: Keep shared plugin installation but require explicit force-style acknowledgement before uninstalling a plugin referenced by any Claw.

options.title: Defer shared plugins
options.body: Limit this first package slice to workspace-scoped skills until a separate host/plugin authorization model is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit shared-host consent
recommendation.body: Retain the current exact-plan grant and warning-only uninstall model, contingent on real shared-plugin proof and stack-level upgrade review.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared plugin-management and uninstall behavior is the most direct owner boundary for this policy.
